visual_identity.core_identity: A veteran hobgoblin officer whose authority comes from disciplined posture, better equipment, and command presence.
visual_identity.silhouette: Medium athletic goblinoid with upright stance, squared shoulders.
visual_identity.head_features: Angular mature goblinoid face, pointed ears, stern brows, controlled expression, visible scars kept sparse.
visual_identity.body_shape: Athletic soldierly humanoid, slightly broader than a rank-and-file hobgoblin but never bulky.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth skin with a few scars; simple armor planes suitable for coloring.
